title: POST <deploy URL>
description: A deploy event the production pipeline posts to the operator, with the app's deploy token (OPStead contract 0.5, what changed and when). Production only; a run that fails at any step posts failed.

app.description: The app's name; must be the deploy token's app.

commit.description: A commit's hex id, full or short (at least 7).

repo.description: The repository's https address, with no credential.
